reason: Real: the setup closure spawns openbb-mcp and sec-edgar-mcp on threads and then joins both before start_main_sidecar (lib.rs:476-491), with each bind waiting up to 45s x 2 attempts (lib.rs:79,84). A timed-out child is killed and its env var removed, so a late bind is lost for the whole session (openbb_mcp.rs:160-171, openbb_mcp.rs:59). --onedir is still not taken (both ensure scripts pass --onefile; D76 affirms the workaround). One correction to the mechanism: Tauri 2.11.1 runs the user setup hook inside the event loop's RuntimeRunEvent::Ready callback on the main thread, after the config windows are built (tauri app.rs:1415-1417, 2513-2523). So the joins do not leave a live UI sitting 'disconnected'. They freeze the app's main event loop for the whole bind window (about 25s warm, 34s+ cold, up to 90s). That means fix shape (1) must also move the joins and the main-sidecar spawn off the setup thread, not only stop joining before the spawn. Severity stays high.
